extracted.intended_audience: federal agency procurement/administration officials (e.g., directors of logistics, offices responsible for implementation of OMB circulars)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural directions related to OMB Circular A-109 (Major Systems Acquisition), including referral of implementing memoranda and oversight/review actions by OFPP/OMB. Intended to instruct agency offices about responsibility for implementation and follow-up actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance of responsibility for implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: Director of Logistics requested that your office accept responsibility for the implementation of the subject Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Circular.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memorandum is written to forward an 11 June 1976 memorandum from OMB which advises of the intention of the Office of Federal Procurement Policy (OFPP) to review progress on implementation of the subject circular. Agencies/offices receiving the circular are expected to accept responsibility for its implementation and take appropriate action.

rubrics_metrics.name: OFPP/OMB review of implementation progress
rubrics_metrics.description: This review is intended to assist OFPP in preparing for oversight hearings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office of Federal Procurement Policy intends to review progress on implementation of OMB Circular A-109; such reviews are a preparatory step for OMB/OFPP oversight hearings. Agencies should expect follow-up examinations of how the circular has been carried out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referral of follow-up memorandum for action
rubrics_metrics.description: The memorandum referred to in paragraph 2 is a direct followup to the subject circular and, therefore, is referred to your office for appropriate action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When OMB/OFPP issues memoranda that directly follow a circular, those memoranda are to be referred to the designated agency office (e.g., logistics or administration) for appropriate action to implement the guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject scope: Major Systems Acquisition (OMB Circular A-109)
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB Circular A-109, Major Systems Acquisition (title/subject of the forwarded memorandum and review).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document being forwarded and reviewed is OMB Circular A-109 concerning major systems acquisition; recipients should treat the circular as authoritative policy guidance governing major systems procurement and related oversight activities.
